Register Field Explanation:
Driver Strength Select Value. Supported only for 1.8V signaling. Meaningless for 3.3V.
11b=Driver Type D selected
10b=Driver Type C selected
01b=Driver Type A selected
00b=Driver Type B selected

Clock Generator Select Value. Effective when Host Controller supports programmable clock generator.
1=Programmable Clock Generator
0=Host Controller Ver2.00 Compatible Clock Generator
SDCLK Frequency Select Value. 10-bit preset value to set SDCLK Frequency Select in Clock Control Register.
